agent.problem: The card uses the burning lamps from Luke 12:35 as well as the master's return and the servants being found on watch in Luke 12:37, but it cites only Luke 12:37. The citation is narrower than the verses the card tells.

rule.text: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: Cards 4 and 5 refer to "that manager," and cards 8 and 10 refer to "that servant," relying on earlier cards instead of identifying the person within the question. Cards 8 and 10 are especially unclear because they do not say that this is the servant who decided his master was delayed and began beating the other servants.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.

agent.problem: The setup says only that the master cuts the servant to pieces. Nothing in the earlier cards lets the baker reason out "unbelievers" rather than "strangers" or "beggars," so the blank asks for wording the baker has not seen.

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
